blocking_failure_classes.summary: Deterministic calibration (A_g, c_g) and residual bias b_r are not separately identifiable; an exact 3-dimensional gauge orbit leaves the gyro packet stream invariant. SC-01 states neither cross-trajectory sharing of (A_g, c_g), nor E[b_r]=0, nor any excitation requirement. On R4 the deterministic split is unrecoverable by construction.

No numeric parameter supports exist for R1-R4. The declared primary method-lock endpoint (R4) is not implementable, R4 disjointness is unfalsifiable, and SC-01's ban on post-test-access support changes has no referent.

G3's 'includes zero' disjunct fires whenever 1.96*SE(N3S-N2) >= D-L, so a decorative feature path passes at rates up to ~0.73 under a true null; pass probability increases with imprecision. The primary condition L >= 0.5*D is point-estimate-only while G0/G1/G2 require CIs.

Divergence is undefined though G4 conditions on it; seed aggregation is defined only for G1/G2, leaving G0/G3/G4 free; the bootstrap resampling/clustering unit is ambiguous and the pooled reading understates CI half-width by up to sqrt(3); the two-of-three-seeds rule names no statistic and no record schema.

Zero overlap between SC-00's 13 frozen red-path identifiers and the 7 cited in the sealed handoff. No claim covers causal ordering or deterministic-vs-residual separation. No red path falsifies learned-compensator residual-bias retention, intra-timestamp stage order, or the right-error reset. Several existing red paths are vacuous unless fixture conditions are stated.

material_findings.summary: SC-00:11 'nor the correction produced at t' admits two incompatible readings; Reading B would make the N3/G2/G3 architecture illegal. Two incompatible implementations of test_sc_causal_prefix_invariance_red follow.

C3 undercounts (1350 vs 1800: N3 branch routing uncounted); C6 undercounts (270 vs 450: G1's R1 and R2 populations uncounted). The handoff is excluded from the manifest, so claims and populations can change without altering the sealed digest.

Derangement permutation sharing across time indices is unspecified; an independent per-index permutation bundles a second intervention that inflates L favorably. Strata of size 1 make derangement impossible and silently degrade to identity.
R4 is held out only over calibration-parameter support; initial states, orbit phases, and noise streams are not required disjoint, weakening the OOD framing of the primary endpoint.
G2 uses (N3-N2), G3 uses D = N2-N3, and G1's CI contrast is never named.

Charter section 12 requires a run budget for runs over 30 minutes; no wall-time, CPU/GPU/RAM, parallelism, disk, or stop-condition record exists, and prompt 05's required-output list has no carrier for it.
Imported frozen modules are not hashed by the manifest and the working tree is dirty, so the commit pin does not establish the content of the reused math across sequential stages.
DECISION_LEDGER.md is byte-identical to its template and records no DR0 seal entry.
